stacks.name: a4R R push stop with the jacking couple: the stop is set by jacking the tongue 24 mm below the cell axis, the grip pushes on the axis (engagement above 1.2 x FS, fraction of FS)

terms.what: designer terms (pen mark, touch, hold, thermal) as in the designer's push-stop row
jacking couple: 1.2 FS x stop arm^2 / leaf-pair rotational stiffness (E 3000), over dfs_ref
terms.tol: =1.2 * 196.2 * stop_z * stop_z / (3000.0 * 2 * cart_hw * leaf_t / leaf_free_len * leaf_pitch * leaf_pitch / 2) / dfs_ref

stacks.name: a4R R push range lost to a 100 N downward lean on the grip (link turns about the cell; tongue 24 mm below), fraction of FS

terms.what: 100 N x (grip y 219.5 - leaf centroid) / k_rot x stop arm, over dfs_ref
terms.tol: =100 * (219.5 - (link0 + link1) / 2) / (3000.0 * 2 * cart_hw * leaf_t / leaf_free_len * leaf_pitch * leaf_pitch / 2) * (-stop_z) / dfs_ref
